name: ccmms
description: Polyglot microservices platform for a campus merchandise marketplace — distributed locking, saga rollback, and event-driven notifications behind flash-sale checkout.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/user-service" "npm run dev -w services/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w services/order-service" "npm run dev -w services/notification-service"

author: RajaiTarun
